item.description: British-Norwegian Composer Kyle Sevenoaks Unveils New Track! “Watch It Burn” Set For Release On Halloween! “Watch It Burn”, the new track from British-Norwegian composer Kyle Sevenoaks, is set for release on October 31st, 2025!
